testcase.name: Scenario: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-docking-system-source/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:31:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport ✔ When the user drags the panel boundary away from the viewport ✔ Then the panel becomes wider ✔ And the viewport becomes narrower by the corresponding amount ✔ And the panel contents and active part remain visible ✔ When the user drags the boundary back ✔ Then the panel and viewport return to their previous proportions
